the harness reads no deviation list path, because the ownership map gives none.

Open points carried from the source gaps, settled in the source documents' owner stories and not in this story. (a) ACE source data is read only through rwb-source-data. Steps carry the source field names that the rwb-source-data contract returns, and no step reads an ACE view or an ACE table directly; the boundary test fails the build on either read. The party-flag, deceased-marker and freshness fields are to be confirmed with P1 before the wave 2 system test. (b) The case-record deviation read has no path in the Ownership Map. It is an open question owned by the Solution architect with the S8 business analyst, to be settled in the S8 contract story before the screen is built. The clear operation keeps the PATCH path that the Ownership Map records; the POST clear form on Architecture v5 slide 15 is settled in the same S8 contract story. (c) The approval the FSD names on a deviation is a step inside DeviationWorkflow, taken by the role the code assigns; the decision-record library writes the decision log entry and its hash. A P7 ApprovalWorkflow edge is an open question for the Solution architect and is not recorded here.
